title: StrictLocalInjectiveSourceSections
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$, $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{et}}))$, $n\in\mathbf Z$, and $Q$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry]. Let $J$ be a specified bounded-below injective complex on $X$ and $q:K\cong QJ$ a specified isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]. Use the actual termwise sections cohomology $B_g$, chain-level restrictions $r_{a,g,h}$, and canonical sections comparisons $c_g$ defined in [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison]. Let $F_i=\operatorname{Hom}(\mathbf Z[V_i][0],(Rf_*K)[n])$, with precomposition transitions, and $\ell_i$ its canonical germ source leg [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs]. There exist isomorphisms $A_i:F_i\cong B_{t_i}$ such that $F(a)=A_j\,r_{D(a),t_j,t_i}\,A_i^{-1}$ for every $a:i\to j$. Moreover, $\ell_i$ followed by the sections homology map of the strict-local mate equals $A_i$ followed by $r_{Q_i,t_i,p}$, $c_p$, and the inverse of the exact-sections Leray target isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-mate-projection-data]. These are comparisons with the concrete complex of sections of $J$, not the stage hypercohomology isomorphisms of the item. No colimit, continuity, or invertibility of the mate or of $c_p$ is asserted.

proof.text: Construct e_i by the explicit injective direct-image, Hom-complex and free-generator sections comparison. All isomorphisms in this construction are proved using the right-derived unit, K-injective localization and Yoneda.
Use the uncancelled transition square F(a) e_i.hom = e_j.hom r_a. Cancel e_i.hom and simplify its inverse-hom identity to obtain the conjugation formula. This cancellation is written in Lean.
Use the cone-leg compatibility of this same explicitly constructed e, and assemble it with the transition formula and the family of isomorphisms.

theorem exists_strictLocalInjectiveSourceSections {X S : Scheme.{v}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (n : ℤ) (Q : StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry f s)
    (J : CochainComplex.Plus (InjectiveObject
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})))
    (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) :
    ∃ e : ∀ i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
      (strictLocalCohomologyNeighbourhoodFunctor s
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).obj K) n).obj (op i) ≅
        termwiseSectionsCohomology ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).obj i)
          (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
            ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj
                (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) n,
      (∀ {i j : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)} (a : i ⟶ j),
        (strictLocalCohomologyNeighbourhoodFunctor s
          ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).obj K) n).map a.op =
          (e j).hom ≫
            termwiseSectionsRestriction ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map a)
              ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app j)
              ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)
              ((Category.comp_id _).symm.trans
                ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).naturality a).symm)
              (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj) n ≫
            (e i).inv) ∧
      (∀ i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
        ((strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs s
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).obj K) n).app (op i)) ≫
        ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s).smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).map
          ((mateEquiv (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).derivedPlus
            (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).derivedPlus
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f
                (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).toCommSq).hom))
                |>.natTrans.app K))) =
            (e i).hom ≫
              termwiseSectionsRestriction (Q.legs.app i)
                ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)
                (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
                (Q.over i).symm
                (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj) n ≫
              representativeSectionsComparison
                (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) q n ≫
              (strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso f s K n).inv)
